title: Hammrod honors Laredo police officers who also served in the military this Veterans Day
excerpt: On Veterans Day, Hammrod News Laredo TX paid tribute to the current and former Laredo police officers who also served in the United States Armed Forces — officers who wore both the military uniform and the LPD badge.
content:
On Veterans Day, Hammrod News Laredo TX paid tribute to the current and former officers of the Laredo Police Department who also served in the United States Armed Forces.

The tribute recognized officers who wore the uniform of the military and now — or once — wear the badge of the Laredo Police Department, honoring lives spent protecting others at home and abroad.

"Their commitment to service, sacrifice, honor, and duty deserves our deepest gratitude and respect," Hammrod News said in its Veterans Day post, thanking the officers and their families for the sacrifices they made and the freedoms they helped defend.

The post honored officers still patrolling Laredo's streets, those who have retired from law enforcement, and those who have moved on to new chapters — saying their contributions will never be forgotten.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, Nov. 11, 2026.
